pages.text: Like the $(l:getting_started/infused_pickaxe)Infused Pickaxe$(/l), this pickaxe can be used to mine Tier 2 Otherworld Materials such as $(item)Iesnium Ore$(). As it is made from metal, instead of brittle $(item)Spirit Attuned Gem$(), it is very durable and can be used for a long time.$(br)
